$comment: Motion library: every scene component, its purpose, status and where it has been used. Approval status refers to the CLIENT's approval of the treatment. Updated by the pipeline/Director when lessons are produced.

components.name: SectionTitle
components.purpose: Chapter opener at real teaching transitions
components.character: Outlined oversized numeral, tracked kicker, self-drawing rule, serif title rising word by word; 2% drift

components.name: KineticStatement
components.purpose: A principle stated with typographic weight
components.character: Masked word rise synced to speech; accent italic emphasis; 3.5% push-in

components.name: QuietReflection
components.character: Near-still; soft focus-pull reveal; single accent dot

components.name: StepsDiagram
components.character: Single path travels node to node, arriving as each step is spoken; focus on current step; vertical in portrait

components.name: ConnectionMetaphor
components.purpose: Relationship between two people or ideas
components.character: Two whole circles converge; shared space lit, forms never merge

components.name: Comparison
components.character: Divider draws; columns arrive with narration; preferred side focuses last

components.name: Takeaway
components.character: Numbered points accumulate with drawn rules as they are spoken

components.name: CourseIntro
components.character: 'The Folder': blind-embossed link rings on royal card stock revealed by raking light; cream index card slides up; wordmark on tab

components.name: StatementCollision
components.character: 'Editorial Collision': letterpress headline over two lines, script word crossing between them

components.name: IntroductionPath
components.purpose: Process with a joining outcome (2–4 stages)
components.character: 'Two Journeys': two lines converge through stage gates into link rings

components.name: ReflectionField
components.character: 'Oxblood Stillness': soft line reveals, script phrase, slow ring draw, long gentle hand-off

components.name: SummaryLedger
components.character: 'The Ledger': royal spine with emboss, ruled rows entered as spoken, brand sign-off

components.name: ParallelPhrases
components.status: PROPOSED (in L01 preview, awaiting client confirmation)
components.character: Ruled equal columns (2–3 items in one row; 4 items in landscape as a 2x2 grid at h2). Used in L01 for s003 (text version, client preferred over ConvergingPaths) and s006

components.name: PathLandscape
components.status: PROPOSED (in L01 preview, awaiting client confirmation)
components.character: Paper-cut layered hills with parallax, path unrolling to a rising sun, stepping stones (first one glows on cue)

components.name: ConvergingPaths
components.status: PROPOSED; withdrawn from L01 (client: 'looks cheap and extra with no meaning'); s003 reverted to parallelPhrases
components.purpose: Several kinds of people/starting points leading to one shared thing
components.character: Coloured paths from labelled starts join into one road to a doorway that opens and lights up

components.name: FindingBecoming
components.status: PROPOSED (in L01 preview, awaiting client confirmation)
components.purpose: Contrast between searching outward and growing inward
components.character: Compass needle searches; seedling grows in a pot; compass recedes
